name: Alabama
standard: Section 508 (legacy checklist; no WCAG version named) — federal floor WCAG 2.1 AA

laws.cite: 28 C.F.R. Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web and mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by DOJ interim final rule 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: State and local governments must make web content and mobile apps conform to WCAG 2.1 AA.

applies_to: Executive Branch agencies, boards and commissions (except those exempt under Code of Alabama Title 41 Ch. 4 Art. 11) using alabama.gov or state.al.us domains.

deadlines.what: Federal ADA Title II floor: public entities with population 50,000+ must meet WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24)
Federal ADA Title II floor: entities under 50,000 and special districts (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: Alt text on every graphic; empty alt on decorative images
An alternative way (email or phone) to complete online forms
Avoid frames; test in multiple browsers
mobile: not addressed — the state standard predates mobile apps; only the federal Title II rule covers them.
procurement: No accessibility procurement requirement found in the state standard.
enforcement: No state enforcement mechanism in the standard; it points to DOJ ADA complaints.
notes: No Alabama statute on digital accessibility found. Standard 530S2 is a dated Section 508 checklist and names no WCAG level (a third-party summary claiming WCAG 2.0 AA was wrong). OIT's Q2 2026 newsletter only notes the DOJ deadline extension. Policy 530 was not opened. Federal floor: ADA Title II rule (WCAG 2.1 AA, web + mobile apps) applies to all state and local government regardless of state law; DOJ's 2026-04-20 interim final rule moved compliance dates to 2027-04-26 / 2028-04-26.
